titles.title: 社長と一線を超えた夜

description:
"Sleep with me, sir."

It was the last night we would never see again. Ahead of her arranged marriage, she had to put an end to her long unrequited love.

"I'm willing to go that far." 

After this night, all emotions are cut off, Moon Jeong-hoo of Moo-sung Motors and his secretary Yoon Hee-jae. It seemed like I could go back to normal.

"I know. That it would be comfortable for both of us if nothing had happened. But... that doesn't work. Do it one more time, us. Just like Secretary Yoon wanted that night.”

But the moment I slept with him the second time, it was really irreversible.
